subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should the optional maxBytes argument become a supported plugin SDK contract for generated-image parsing, or should pre-decode enforcement remain behind an internal/provider-owned boundary?
rationale: The option is additive and useful, but it changes an exported helper used by bundled plugins; repository policy requires explicit maintainer-visible direction for plugin API surface changes.

options.title: Approve the additive option
options.body: Keep the optional maxBytes argument, add or confirm focused SDK compatibility coverage, and treat it as the canonical generic budget seam.

options.title: Keep the guard internal
options.body: Move budget enforcement into provider-owned or internal wrappers so the shipped plugin SDK signature does not expand.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive option
recommendation.body: Keep the optional maxBytes argument, add or confirm focused SDK compatibility coverage, and treat it as the canonical generic budget seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this person to both the CLI execution boundary and image-generation provider surface affected by the API choice.
